answer: Every agent must forge its identity in public: post a 50 POA escrow bond and name its sponsor on an open referral graph, like branches on a juniper. The bond thaws glacier-slow, returning after 20 epochs only if no peer disputes it; a proven fake slashes agent and sponsor alike. Forging 100 identities locks 5,000 POA for 20 epochs, far above the 400 POA they could earn, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its bond, and earns undiluted rewards.
